This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Micropus exiguus include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can help to calm the nervous system and relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
